description:
Add the five seam fields to the gemm, triangular and ple profile families.

## Background

The proof-surface seam design (dev/active/7d7c647c/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §3 fixes the three-part seam with probe-verified surface claims, §4 gives each field its name, kind, range, default-naming constant, mechanism and route-observation obligation, §5 records the decisions (D1 direct removal, D2 lane split, D3 opaque pin, D4 default naming, D5 public reporters, D6 source-level convention amendments), §6 enumerates the post-processing deletions, and §8 scopes the tasks. The follow-on migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) supplies the shared field-kind, mechanism and test conventions.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: gemm.winograd_min_dim, triangular.base_case_max_dim, ple.scalar_base_max_cols, ple.panel_byte_lane_max_cols and ple.panel_u16_lane_max_cols exist with the ranges seam design §4.2 derives, vocabulary entries, and CONSERVATIVE entries naming the constants of the kernel crate and the hoisted defaults; the two lane fields' ranges cap at their kernels' asserted bounds.
- [hard] REQ-02: The JSON round trip and conservative.json regeneration pass; no selector site changes.
title: Extend the tuning schema with the seam fields
